How to Apply
Deadlines
Deadlines for Applying, Registering, and Enrolling
Please find the deadlines for the winter semester 2026/2027 here.
Important note for international applicants with non-german university entrance qualifications:
The same deadlines apply to all applications with non-german educational qualifications (see below). In addition to your application, you must apply for a VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation, preliminary review documentation) at uni-assist. Please apply for the VPD as early as possible, as processing can take several weeks. All information about the VPD for bachelor's and master's degrees, as well as the VPD-FAQ, can be found on our website.
Undergraduate Degree Programs
Expand allCollapse all
Bachelor's Degrees and State Exam Law applicants
Degree programs with one subject (“Mono bachelor”) and state examination degree programs
Applications for degree programs with limited admission:
01.06.2026 – 15.07.2026
Formal notifications of admission will be sent out from mid-August onward. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Applications for degree programs with unrestricted admission:
01.06.2026 – 01.09.2026
Formal notifications to enroll will be sent out gradually throughout the application period. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadline for accepting your study placement.
Combined bachelor’s degree programs (“Combi bachelor”)
Applications where at least one component (core subject or additional module[s]) has limited admission:
01.06.2026 – 15.07.2026
Formal notifications of admission will be sent out from mid-August onward. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Applications where all components have unrestricted admission:
01.06.2026 – 01.09.2026
Formal notifications to enroll will be sent out gradually throughout the application period. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadline for accepting your study placement.
Pharmacy and veterinary medicine applicants
You can find further information on the website for applicants who want to study pharmacy and veterinary medicine.
Applications for “Alt-Abiturient*innen” (applicants who completed their university entrance qualification before January 16, 2026), entering the first semester of a degree program, via hochschulstart.de:
28.04.2026 – 31.05.2026
Applications for “Neu-Abiturient*innen” (applicants who completed their university entrance qualification after January 16, 2026), entering the first semester of a degree program, via hochschulstart.de:
28.04.2026 – 15.07.2026
Application period for applicants who are not citizens of the EU and do not have a German university entrance qualification (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) via uni-assist:
01.06.2026 – 15.07.2026
Application period for higher semesters via the application portal of the FU Berlin for applicants with German university entrance qualification (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) and via uni-assist for applicants without German university entrance qualification (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung):
01.06.2026 – 15.07.2026
Applicants with professional/vocational school qualifications or occupational training
You can find further information on the website for applicants who have professional/vocational school qualifications or occupational training.
Applications for reviews of documentation from applicants with professional/vocational school qualifications or occupational training:
01.12.2025 – 31.05.2026
The usual deadlines for undergraduate degree programs apply to applicants who have professional/vocational school qualifications or occupational training.
Deadlines for the admission exam for applicants with professional/vocational school qualifications or occupational training and for preparatory courses can be found on the Studienkolleg website.
Studienkolleg (preparatory course) and external assessment exams/additional exams
Applications for undergraduate degree programs via uni-assist:
01.06.2026 – 15.07.2026
You can find further information regarding the entrance exam on the Studienkolleg website.
Applications for external assessment exams or additional exams (without the applicant having first attended the Studienkolleg preparatory course) are only accepted in the run-up to the summer semester and are open from December 1 onward via uni-assist.
Exchanges of study placements
You can find further information on the exchange of study placements website.
Final deadline 06.10.2026
Master’s Degree Programs
Expand allCollapse all
Consecutive master’s degree programs
Applications for master’s degree programs with limited admission (first semester in the degree program):
20.04.2026 – 31.05.2026
This application period applies for all semesters within the master’s degree program.
Formal notifications of admission will be sent out from the end of June onward. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Applications for master’s degree programs with unrestricted admission (first semester)
20.04.2026 – 15.08.2026
This application period applies for all semesters within the master’s degree program.
Formal notifications of admission will be sent out gradually from the start of the application period and beyond its end. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Master’s degree programs in education
20.04.2026 – 15.08.2026
This application period applies for all semesters within the master’s degree program.
Formal notifications of admission will be sent out gradually from the start of the application period and beyond its end. Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Lottery procedure
01.09.2026 – 10.09.2026
A lottery procedure only takes place if there are still study places available after the admission procedures have been completed. You can find further information and places on degree programs offered via the lottery procedure on the lottery procedure website.
Continuing education master’s degree programs
Application deadlines for continuing education master’s degree programs:
School Development in Line with Teaching of Democratic Principles and Social Skills:
20.04.2026 – 31.08.2026
European and International Business, Competition, and Regulatory Law:
01.12.2025 – 31.03.2026
Futures Studies:
20.04.2026 – 30.06.2026
Please consult the formal notification of admission for further information, as this will state the deadlines for accepting your study placement and for enrollment.
Academic Calendar
Application for winter semester
These are the general application periods for the winter semester:
Bachelor and state examination programmes
1.6. - 15.7. restricted admission programmes (with NC)
1.6. - 1.9. unrestricted admission programmes (without NC)
Master's programmes
15.4. - 31.5. restricted admission programmes (with NC)
15.4. - 15.8. Unrestricted admission programmes (without NC)
The exact dates can vary and will be published for the respective year on this website each March.
